title: PowerPoint on Mac: attach and reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot Agent Mode
summary: Hold: licence assignment is not the only documented way to restrict Copilot in PowerPoint. Microsoft explicitly says connected-experience privacy controls disable Copilot features in PowerPoint on Mac, so the briefing's statement that their applicability is unstated could mislead administrators. The default classification, rollout absence and overly broad billing statement also need correction.
